verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for crypto payment products, since self-hostable crypto payment processors exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted deployment of Stripe's crypto or stablecoin services. Every capability described runs as Stripe-managed infrastructure (settlement into the Stripe balance, Stripe-hosted onramp, Financial Accounts), and the MCP server, CLI and sandbox are adjacent tooling, not a self-hostable core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
